name: Ghoul Matriarch
summary: A bloated, crowned ghoul that commands a pack by hunger and scent.
description: The matriarch is the oldest of her kind in a warren, and the pack takes its orders from her nose. She sends the weak ahead, saves the freshest meals for herself, and eats the dead leaders she once served.

traits.name: Aura of Hunger
traits.text: Allies within 10 feet of the matriarch have {ref:glossary/advantage} on attack rolls against creatures that don't have all their Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The matriarch makes two Corpse-Tongue attacks and uses Command the Pack if it is available.

actions.name: Corpse-Tongue
actions.onHit: If the target is a creature that isn't an Undead, it must succeed on a {dc:dex} Constitution saving throw or have the {ref:condition/paralyzed} condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Command the Pack
actions.text: Each Undead of the matriarch's choice within 60 feet of her that can hear her moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and makes one melee attack.
